rail_math.cos: system IEEE-754 primitive; bootstrap and native geometry
rail_math.exp: system IEEE-754 primitive; native demand/temporal kernels
rail_math.log: system IEEE-754 primitive; native demand kernels
rail_math.log1p: system IEEE-754 primitive; native demand kernels
rail_math.pow: system IEEE-754 primitive; native demand kernels
rail_math.random: external entropy primitive; draws and model RNG transitions are selected and owned in Rust
rail_math.now: monotonic observation for native work budgets, never game-time advancement

ports.Worker: create/terminate/postMessage/event forwarding; leases, request identities, invalidation and unknown commit policy in platform.rs
ports.Timer: schedule/cancel a native-selected timeout and report ticket/epoch
ports.IndexedDB: transaction and compare-and-write primitives; persistence policy in persistence.rs
ports.Storage: read/set/compare-and-remove primitives; serialization and cleanup authorization in Rust
ports.File: choose/read/download bytes; format and bounds in Rust
ports.DOM: layout, text, locale formatting, presentation filters, screen geometry and interpolation

mathReplacement: Keep system primitives for current floating-point parity. Replacing implementations requires independent deterministic comparison before adoption.
hostJson: Removed from current Rust diagnostic/signature path; no rail_host.json_utf8 import in current source. Frozen artifacts retain their historical ABI.
